name: (18) Animalism — 3 Advanced — Taunt the Caged Beast

system.description:
With no more than a fleeting brush you rouse the Beast in another, commanding your own to threaten its spiritual territory and lash it into a killing rage.

Touch the subject (a Physical Challenge may be needed against an unwilling target) and expend a Willpower Trait, then make a Social Challenge. Winning forces the subject into immediate frenzy — even mortals and others who would not normally frenzy; losing sends you into frenzy instead. Retest with Animal Ken.
